eased-transitions-yuv420p-script.txt (from scriptituk/xfade-easing, MIT, see LICENSE) contains ffmpeg ports of the
gl-transitions shaders (https://github.com/gl-transitions/gl-transitions). Each shader keeps its author's licence: most
are MIT (author and licence in each shader's header upstream). Two are under BSD licences, whose notices follow.
